name: With my hpBar bugs
detailed_description:
About This Game

With my hpBar bugs is a unique 2D platformer puzzle game where your health bar isn’t just for survival—it’s your main tool for interacting with the world.

In this game, you control a character who can only move left and right. There’s no jumping. Instead, your health bar acts as a physical object in the game world. You can increase or decrease your HP to change the size and shape of the bar, allowing it to press buttons, block hazards, bridge gaps, or trigger mechanisms.

Every level is a carefully crafted puzzle that challenges you to think creatively with limited movement. From navigating tight spaces to manipulating moving platforms, you’ll need to master the art of health management to progress.

Key features:

  • 🧩 Innovative puzzle mechanics centered around a physical health bar

  • 🕹️ Simple controls: no jumping, only left and right movement

  • 🏆 40+ handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty

  • ⚙️ Dynamic environments and interactive elements that respond to your HP

  • 🎮 Keyboard and controller support

If you love puzzle platformers, clever mechanics, and games that turn simple ideas into deep challenges, With my hpBar bugs will surprise you in the best way.
